content:
maria_ae: Quick SIG check-in for AcmeCorp — they emailed back asking for per-question artifacts for about 18 specific items (encryption, key rotation, access reviews, backup verification). I uploaded their XLSX to the thread. POC kickoff Tue morning; customer wants evidence by EOD Monday. Who can own which questions?

ajay_se: I can take the infra/encryption questions (Q7, Q8, Q14). I have a scrubbed KMS rotation summary we can share. Can someone confirm the canonical S3 path for sharing artifacts?

sam_security: I’ll cover the access control / IAM questions (Q3, Q4, Q5) and the incident response ones (Q17). FYI the full KMS rotation runbook is in Confluence (internal) — I exported a redacted PDF last week. I’ll drop the sanitized version into a shareable bucket.

priya_csm: Thanks — I’ll coordinate with AcmeCorp on any redaction requests and track what gets accepted as "evidence" on their side. If they need signed SOC2 excerpts, we have the customer-friendly SOC2 extract we can attach.

connor_se: Tagging a quick checklist: 1) artifact (PDF/diagram) 2) short one-line answer for the Q 3) pointer to original policy/location 4) contact owner. If we stick to that format we're faster. I’ll draft the one-line answers for the infra bits Ajay is taking.

redwood-bot: Attachment uploaded: acmecorp_SIG_questions.xlsx (uploaded by maria_ae) :file_folder:

ajay_se: S3 path I usually use for SIG uploads: s3://redwood-sec/sig-uploads/acmecorp/1798765432/ — permissions are ACL-blocked and objects are encrypted with cmk-redwood-prod. I’ll upload the KMS-redacted-runbook there.

sam_security: Uploaded redacted-runbook as runbook_kms_rotation_redacted_v1.pdf to that path. Also uploaded the access-review-export (last90days) as access_review_2026-02.csv.

ajay_se: Dropped a short diagram (arch_kv_cache_network_v2.png) and the config snippet customers usually expect. Snippet: 

```
# example snippet we give for TLS enforcement
server:
  tls: required
  tls_versions: ["1.2","1.3"]
```

maria_ae: Perfect — can someone paste direct presigned URLs (short expiry) into the thread? AcmeCorp security team prefers direct links over onboarding ticket attachments.

connor_se: Presigned links (48h) uploaded: 
- runbook_kms_rotation_redacted_v1.pdf: https://redwood-presign.example/runbook_kms_rotation_redacted_v1.pdf?exp=48h
- arch_kv_cache_network_v2.png: https://redwood-presign.example/arch_kv_cache_network_v2.png?exp=48h
- access_review_2026-02.csv: https://redwood-presign.example/access_review_2026-02.csv?exp=48h

sam_security: Note: access_review export includes internal usernames; I removed PII but left team tags. If AcmeCorp requests different pseudonymization, tell me ASAP.

priya_csm: Maria — I’ll draft the email to AcmeCorp with the links and the one-line answers. I’ll also include the SOC2 extract and the security contact (sam_security). Do we need anything else for Q12 (backup verification)?

ajay_se: For Q12 — backup test run logs are in vault at `/backups/tests/2026/weekly-restore-log-2026-01-30.log`. I exported the last successful restore summary and uploaded as backup_restore_summary_2026-01-30.pdf.

maria_ae: Awesome, thank you. Final ask: can we get a short statement about our model data handling (PII minimization) — one sentence acceptable — because AcmeCorp has a data residency question too.

sam_security: Suggested line: "Redwood Inference does not persist customer prompt/response data for hosted customers by default; when persisted for analytics or debugging, data is encrypted at rest with customer-separated CMKs and access is audited." Feel free to tweak.

connor_se: I'll add a short note: "For dedicated/private deployments, customers control KEKs/KMS and data never leaves the VPC unless explicitly configured."

maria_ae: Great. Priya — once you send the email, can you paste the reply here so we can check if they accept the artifacts or ask follow-ups? I want to loop legal if they request signed attestations.

priya_csm: Will do — drafting now. ETA 1h.

redwood-bot: Reminder: scheduled POC kickoff meeting for AcmeCorp at 2026-03-24T09:00Z (created by maria_ae) :calendar:
